notes.title: Game updated & Devblog 12/29/2019
notes.content:
Greetings, friends! 
First of all, sorry for a long silence. No, the game is not abandoned! We just decided to spend more time on development instead of posting tiny updates. Through this year we made many improvements and so much things is still to be done.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/dc052d9cc6931f7625c473f91dce706659e99a16.png

1) Levels of the third act
Levels 1-9 is totally ready right now. Levels 10 and 11 is ready, but without cutscenes. New mechanics and puzzles are in third act, and storyline is progressing in unexpected ways :D

2) Interface reworked
Many times we heard about too much “mobile” interface in the game. So we reworked big part of it. We add animations in main menu; level’s previews; decrease size of interface elements and fonts; add contextual tooltips. Now you can change screen resolution during the game in ‘Settings’. In ‘Victory’ menu some statistics will be shown.

3) Posteffects
Some postrender effects added to the game. However, it is strongly WIP (work-in-progress) effects and we going to rework and improve it. If you will not enjoy this kind of effects - just turn it off.

4) New sprites
Sprites of the portals, doors and keys were redrawn. New textures is more detailed and qualitative. Many particle effects were reworked too.

[previewyoutube=ABtFaWoTOmU;full][/previewyoutube]
5) Level editor
First, very early beta version of the editor. Yes, it is uncomfortable and not intuitive by now. You can’t save created levels permanently for now. Little, uncritical bugs in the editor. But it is totally work, with all gameplay elements and puzzles. Try to create a puzzle of your dream! :D

[previewyoutube=6f09prNUtrs;full][/previewyoutube]
6) Many little improvements and bug fixes
* The turn doesn’t count when the character stays in front of a wall.
* Early, when walkthrough was turned on, and you were trying to switch characters, you could lose controls.
* Fixed bugs with ‘Undo turn’ in the final level ot the Pyramid
* Fixed bugs with statistic saving.
* And many more…

Also, we reduce base price in euro. Price in other currencies will not be changed. 

We will be very grateful, if you will try this update and leave us some feedback! Good luck and Happy New Year!

 Twitter 
 Facebook 
 VK 
 YouTube 
 Official site 

 Have a nice game!

notes.title: Devblog 12/29/2018
notes.content:
Greetings, friends! ːsteamhappyː
We haven’t post any news about the development of Maze Of Adventures. So here is some information for you, especially since there are several good reasons!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/dc052d9cc6931f7625c473f91dce706659e99a16.png

First of all, I would like to congratulate all of you on the upcoming New Year! We wish you happiness and success in the new year, and a good luck of course!

Also we are proud to tell you about our new game, that we made literally in one month. This is a short (15-20 minutes) parody pixel art top-down zombie shooter DOKA 2 GUTS OUT NINJA. Try it, because the game is cost almost nothing. And do not take it too seriously! :D

https://youtu.be/3JlPhwQdWU4

And now about the development.

1) Steam Winter Sale 2018
An annual winter sale is currently going on. And our game is also involved in it. Right now you can purchase the game with a discount of 26%!

2) Demo version of the game
A couple of months ago we made a demo version. It contains a few levels so you can try it before you buy. You can download the demo and try the game on the Store Page.

3) Work on the third Act (Japan)
Well, finally! We are already doing the third act about the adventures of the archeologist John and his sexy friend Clara Loft in search of the mysterious mirror Amaterasu. All graphic content is ready at the moment. Most of the dialogue is also ready and on final polishing now. Finished seven levels in which there will be another new game mechanics. And even more. We plan to update the game in the near future, so that you can try the already finished content on your own.

https://i.imgur.com/bVfqnFD.gif

Be sure to add the game to your wishlist, to make it easier to follow the news. And write your ideas in the comments. This will help make the game better!

notes.title: Big Update! Devblog 08/31/2018
notes.content:
Greetings, friends! ːsteamhappyː
Work on the second chapter is completely 💯 finished. Update is already uploaded on Steam. The details are below.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/dc052d9cc6931f7625c473f91dce706659e99a16.png

1) Levels and puzzles 
All 22 levels of the second chapter are ready. In the chapter with the pyramid you’ll see three new puzzles: a web, a jumper and a lightning wall. And in the final level, you’ll find a surprise - the Battle Royal. Have you ever seen a Battle Royale in a puzzle game?!

https://thumbs.gfycat.com/PerkyUnsightlyDrafthorse-size_restricted.gif

2) The plot 
The plot of the second chapter is also completely ready. New character, new level openings, 155 phrases of dialogues (in the first chapter there was only 102 phrases), the final comic. All of this is already in the game, try it!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/a7da7cb8bfe3711f6991fb7fea996441dc91e5c5.png

3) Сhoice of difficulty level 
Now you can choose the difficulty level in the game! At the easiest level there will be no limit of turns, so the game will be more immersive. And on the most difficult there will be no tips.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/8f6e4a2b5fdfe74713e4a8a53cb54af30331d659.png

notes.title: Weeklong deal and game update!
notes.content:
Greetings, friends! ːsteamhappyː
Game updated on Steam! And we’ll make a weekly discount from April 30!  Add to wishlist, so you will never miss it. 
And for now here’s a devblog for past two weeks.

 http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/dc052d9cc6931f7625c473f91dce706659e99a16.png 

 1) New levels 
We’ve added four new levels in the first chapter.
New levels 3 and 7 are aimed at a more smooth increase in complexity at the beginning of the game. Levels 14 and 19 are complex and interesting. The estimated time for the first chapter is now ~ 1 hour. It used to be ~ 45 minutes.
Three new levels in the second chapter (7, 8, 9). With a new puzzle, about which we wrote earlier - web. Level 5 became more difficult.
The new levels will be marked in the level selection menu. All the progress of the passage is saved, no need to star a new game.

https://i.imgur.com/Md8PO9a.png
https://i.imgur.com/5Ytp4rZ.png

 2) The new puzzle 
Jumper is a new puzzle. It throws the hero aside by 1, 2 or 3 tiles. After that, the jumper turns off. 
If the hero passes through the puzzle turned off - it will be activated again, but the hero will continue to move according to the usual rules.

https://i.imgur.com/WSbOmKa.gif https://i.imgur.com/5b0e9HM.gif https://i.imgur.com/T7mHz1V.gif

notes.title: Devblog 04/14/2018
notes.content:
Greetings, friends! ːsteamhappyː
Here’s the fresh devblog with news for the past week. We are waiting for your opinion in the comments!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/dc052d9cc6931f7625c473f91dce706659e99a16.png

 1) The new puzzle 
We’ve drew sprites and implemented the logic of a new puzzle - Webs. It is placed on the floor tiles.
Webs stops any hero that passes through it. After that, the web collapses. When you re-pass through the web, the hero will continue to move without stopping. The turn cancellation acts on the webs just the same way as on the chests/keys.




 2) Animation fixes 
At last we’ve fix animation of characters! Those who played our game, could notice problems with the animation of Hans. Multiple visual artifacts appeared because the sprites did not fit well to the bones. That's what we did:

 We’ve adjusted the place of limbs joints, because there was a big difference between John and Hans. Now John has a larger chest and the Hans have bigger belly.
 Audited all the skeletons (side view, front, rear). Brought them to a universal scale.
 Re-tied the sprites to the skeletons.
 Reworked some of the animations.
 Found a bug when the animation of the character’s death didn’t play after level reboot.

notes.title: Devblog 03/31/2018
notes.content:
Greetings, friends! ːsteamhappyː
We are proud to announce that next week we plan to update the game.
What’s done over the past two weeks:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/dc052d9cc6931f7625c473f91dce706659e99a16.png

 1) Tips to pass the level 
You don’t know how to pass the level? No problem. Now we have a special button that shows you the next turn. 
If your turn is not the first, the level will be reloaded and after that the tips will be activated. 
If you will disable this option then the level will not be reloaded.

 2) Improved interface of game levels and dialogs 

The GUI is now disabled during the splash screen before the level.
Panels of collected chests and number of moves are grouped with a undo button and moved to the left edge of the screen.
The interface of dialogs has been altered. Added animations during dialogues - portrait of the talking character is now moving up.
Reason of defeat will be shown now.


 3) Bugs fix, code refactoring 
Two unpleasant (but not critical!) bugs were fixed. Plus, a lot of work was done on code refactoring and project architecture. This will avoid a number of possible errors in the future.

https://youtu.be/pworiE2BIhM
 Subscribe, share with friends, write your wishes and criticism. This will help a lot!

notes.title: Devblog 02/08/2018
notes.content:
Greetings, friends! ːsteamhappyː
So, we share some news over the past week. 
Also soon the game will be updated on Steam. Subscribe if you’re interested to try it first!ːsteamhappyː

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/dc052d9cc6931f7625c473f91dce706659e99a16.png

1) Control of two heroes:
- According to the plot of the second chapter, John and Hans are have to unite. Only so they can go through all the traps. Now the levels will become even harder and more interesting!
- Rules of the game will slightly vary:
* Player chooses which character to move
* Number of moves and undos are joint for both characters.
* You can collect keys and chests by any of the characters.
* You need to bring any character to the exit to win.
* You’ll lose if one of the heroes perishes or runs out of turns.
* Each hero is impassable for another

https://i.imgur.com/jRZwq02.gif

2) New levels:
- We’ve made 4 more levels for the second chapter.
- All the levels of the second chapter are without dialogues so far.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/f723a6fe47dd79d01b2665cd938cd9df5328a05b.png

3) Bug fixes and improvements:
- Fixed a bug when each fiery wall was placed on the playing field twice.
- Improved particle FX of keys and chests pickup.
- The entire dialog phrase will be displayed if you press Enter. The next phrase will appear if you press Enter again.
- Modified internal development tools.

notes.title: Devblog 02/01/2018
notes.content:
Greetings, friends ːsteamhappyː
We want to tell you about what has been done recently. We will be glad to receive your feedback and comments! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/dc052d9cc6931f7625c473f91dce706659e99a16.png

1) New interface sprites.
- Level selection menu was modified. 
- New way to display the number of collected chests on level button. 
- Invisible objects from the interface markup are removed. This should improve the performance a little bit.
- Redone the sprite of the "space" key to a more understandable one. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/9dbf3d0da8d14434f4f471afe0a1607d449603cd.png

2) Improved localization.
- Сhapter, level and menu titles are localized now.
- English localization edited according to the Anders Pack review. Many thanks! 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QnPFvDBS2Y8
3) Improved control from the keyboard. 
- The main menu can be scrolled using the arrows or the A \ D keys. 
- Open the level selection menu - Space or Enter
- Close the Menu - Esc. 
- The next phrase in the dialogue - Enter.
- Undo last move - Backspace. 
- Start the next level after winning - Enter. 
- Hero movement - arrows or WASD keys.

4) And much more... 
Level 11 is simplified now; the musical theme of the chapter is playing without restarting; smoother transition of one musical theme to another; the first level of the second chapter is available only after passing the first chapter fully.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/86de0508fe001cd4f6cddedca3c646ebaa13c511.png 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/3500a0df0dba8578d1838bf9338731c7a19ccacb.png 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/5b977e15c99c6191dae7d81bcd504377cb3e55e4.png

Follow us at social networks, leave comments, type your wishes and critics. We are appreciate it!

 Facebook 
 VK 
 YouTube 
 Official site 

p.s.: If you enter a special cheat code in the main menu, all levels will be temporarily available. Try to use a code from the classic Doom and Doom 2 ːsteamhappyː

 Enjoy the game!

notes.title: "Maze of Adventures" is now available in early access!
notes.content:
This day has finally come - our game is now in the early access and available for purchase! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31506794/dc052d9cc6931f7625c473f91dce706659e99a16.png

 Plans for the near future 
We’ve went a long way to this point, but there is still a lot of work ahead. A lot of things that we have planned are waiting for their realization.
In the very near future we will start developing the second chapter - John goes to explore the pyramids of the mysterious Egypt. There are many new levels with new graphics and new puzzles. And most importantly - the continuation of the story Archaeologist John and Hans von Typischerbösewicht!

 Follow us on social media 
We will be very, very, very happy to see all your feedback and suggestions. In our social pages we will show you the development process.

 Facebook 
 VK 
 YouTube 
 Official site 

 Enjoy the game!
